# dsh-mnemon-sync-monitor
Real-time file watcher that keeps dsh-mnemon Project Documents in sync with local Markdown knowledge
bases, and optionally distils those notes into Memory Spaces so they are reachable **by meaning** r
ather than by wording.
dsh-mnemon's Documents Source is a **snapshot store**: it imports files once and never notices later
edits, additions, or deletions. This plugin closes that gap. It watches your knowledge bases and re
conciles changes within a debounce window.
## Why this exists
Measured behaviour of dsh-mnemon 0.5.39 before this plugin:
| Change to your knowledge base | Automatic? | Why |

| New file | No | No file-system watcher anywhere in the Documents Source |
| Edited file | No | The

store holds a **copy**, not a reference |
| Deleted file | No | The copy survives the source foreve

ore holds a **copy**, not a reference |
| Deleted file | No | The copy survives the source forever |
A `grep` for `fs.watch`, `chokidar`, or `FSWatcher` across `dsh-mnemon-source-documents` returns zer
o hits. There is also no reindex path: `index.json` is the only source of truth and nothing rescans
e is also no reindex path: `index.json` is the only source of truth and nothing rescans directories.
## What it does
| Source change | Action |

| New file | Create a document |
| Content hash changed | Update the document in place, `revision +

1` |
| File deleted | Archive the document (only with `prune: true`) |
| Unchanged | Skip |
Changes are coalesced with a debounce window, then applied atomically under the Documents index lock

### Updating a local checkout
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**Use this instead of copying files by hand.** A manual copy once updated
`lib/index.js` but not `li

b/persist.js`; `index.js` imported four names the older
file did not export, so ESM threw at *instan

tiation* - before `apply()` ran. The
symptom was not an error but a disappearance: no log line, no v

isible fault, and
the settings page simply gone after the restart.
The installer removes that failure class:

- it copies the **whole** shipment (every file under `lib/`, the client entry, the
manifest) and nev

er a hand-picked subset;
- it stages into a temporary directory and checks every named import agains

oth pass does it swap the tree into place, keeping the previous
install as a rollback point.

`test/imports.test.js` runs the same checks in CI, so a partial update fails a test
rather than a re

rather than a restart.

> **Restart requirement.** `lib/` is loaded into the Host at startup, so a change
> under `lib/` nee

ds a full DSH restart; `client.js` is picked up by the client HMR
> watcher on a page refresh. If th

e settings page disappears after a restart, the
> plugin threw during module instantiation — run `no

de scripts/install.mjs --dry-run`,
> which reports the offending import by name.

> **A profile row replaces the whole config object.** Write every key you need; a key
> left out is

not merged with the bundle's default, it is *gone*. In particular the
> `distill:` block must exist

in your profile or the Settings switch cannot be
> persisted and distillation never runs.
## Settings page
The bundle ships a Client half: a **Settings → 知识库同步** page with two groups.
**知识库监听** — the watched roots and the add/remove/rescan controls.
| Action | Effect |

| See roots | Each row shows the path, whether it exists, and its Markdown count |
| Add | Validates

the path is an existing directory, then starts watching it immediately |
| Remove | Stops watching;

documents already synced stay in the store |
| Rescan | Runs one reconciliation pass over every wat

ady synced stay in the store |
| Rescan | Runs one reconciliation pass over every watched root now |

**One file, one pipeline.** Watching `.../Vault` and `.../Vault/inner` at the same time
used to mean

every note under `inner` was scanned twice, under two relative paths
(`inner/shared.md` and `shared

.md`), against two independent ledgers — both copies were
dispatched and the model was paid twice. R

oots are now canonicalised before anything is
scanned: the set is de-duplicated by resolved absolute

path (case-insensitively on
Windows), and a root nested inside another configured root is dropped,

because the
**outermost root owns the file**. That rule is order-independent — the ancestor wins
whi

chever order the roots were listed in — and the surviving set is what the pass walks,
what coverage

reports and what this list shows. A dropped root is named as *shadowed* in
the activity log rather t

han vanishing. Adding an overlapping root is refused outright
[该节后续省略]
### What the model actually sees

Before the model is called, a note is cleaned: frontmatter is stripped and fenced
code blocks are dr

the model is called, a note is cleaned: frontmatter is stripped and fenced
code blocks are dropped.

- **Frontmatter must be stripped on both line endings.** Matching only a bare LF
delimiter means a W

indows-saved Obsidian vault keeps its whole YAML block, and the
YAML becomes indexed prose. Measured

: 277 of 352 records in one vault carried a
duplicated `title:`/`tags:` block, which also broke body

-level dedupe — the same
note hashed differently in a CRLF vault and an LF one.
- **Code blocks are

dropped.** An Obsidian note can be almost entirely a Dataview
query — template scaffolding with no k

nowledge in it. Distilling that produces a
description of syntax, not a fact about anything.
- **A n
ote that is only frontmatter** has no indexable text and is skipped.
